title: 2007 AMC 8 Problem 7
statement: The average age of \(5\) people in a room is \(30\) years. An \(18\)-year-old person leaves the room. What is the average age of the four remaining people?

solutions.text:
Initially, the total age of everyone in the room is \(5 \cdot 30 = 150\) years.

After the person leaves, the total age is \(150 - 18 = 132.\) With \(4\) people remaining, the average age becomes \(\dfrac{132}{4} = 33.\)

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Convert the original average into a total age.
Subtract the age of the person who leaves before dividing by the remaining number of people.
